stories.title: Mbappé se retira lesionado en la rodilla izquierda tras marcar ante Turquía

en.title: Mbappé retires injured in left knee after scoring against Turkey
en.summary: Madrid's forward scored the winning goal in Zidane's debut with France but left the match experiencing significant pain from a knee injury.

stories.title: La novia del arquitecto Josep Juanpere, acusada de homicidio, evita la cárcel al hacer efectivo el pago de 80.000 euros de fianza

en.title: Josep Juanpere's girlfriend, accused of homicide, avoids jail by paying 80,000 euros bail
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere, arrested the previous Wednesday in Madrid, avoided jail by paying an 80,000 euro bail. The Vielha court ordered her imprisonment conditional on posting bail.

stories.title: El Gobierno evita responder a un informe de CBS que reaviva la posibilidad de una acción militar en Cuba

en.title: Government avoids responding to CBS report reviving possibility of military action in Cuba
en.summary: CBS reported on a plan evaluating resource mobilization to support Southern Command, which oversees the Caribbean region, but the government did not provide a response.

stories.title: Renfe investiga un ciberataque vinculado a sistemas de Adif que expuso datos básicos de usuarios

en.title: Renfe investigates cyberattack linked to Adif systems that exposed user basic data
en.summary: Renfe is investigating a cyberattack that compromised names and email addresses of users. The company states there is no evidence of banking data exposure or disruption to rail service.

stories.title: El Ejército de EEUU se prepara para una posible acción militar en torno a Cuba, según CBS

en.title: U.S. Army prepares for possible military action around Cuba, according to CBS
en.summary: CBS reported that U.S. military planning related to Cuba involves preparation for potential military action, as explained by U.S. officials, though the message lacked direct Cuba references.

stories.title: Madrid rechaza la propuesta de Urbagestión para asumir el piso de Maricarmen por “inviable”, pero se ofrece a mediar

en.title: Madrid rejects Urbagestión proposal to assume Maricarmen's apartment as "unviable", but offers to mediate
en.summary: Madrid's city council has declined Urbagestión's proposal to take over an apartment case but proposed using its rental intermediation service. Representatives of Maricarmen have agreed to meet Monday with property owners and municipal mediators.

stories.title: Junts plantea al Gobierno suspender los desahucios cuando el inmueble sea de un fondo buitre

en.title: Junts proposes to the Government to suspend evictions when the property belongs to a vulture fund
en.summary: Junts has submitted a royal decree proposal to the government addressing housing measures, including suspending evictions for properties owned by vulture funds. The PSOE is reportedly examining the proposal favorably.

stories.title: El Ayuntamiento de Madrid rechaza la propuesta de Urbagestión "por su inviabilidad legal" y mediará para buscar una solución a Maricarmen

en.title: Madrid City Council rejects Urbagestión proposal "for its legal unfeasibility" and will mediate to find a solution for Maricarmen
en.summary: Madrid's municipal government has rejected Urbagestión's proposal citing legal unfeasibility and will instead seek to mediate a solution. The property owner had offered cooperation with the city's housing authority and social services.

stories.title: La pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere, en libertad provisional tras pagar una fianza de 80.000 euros

en.title: Josep Juanpere's partner released on provisional freedom after paying a bail of 80,000 euros
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere has been released on provisional freedom after paying a bail of 80,000 euros. The woman is under investigation for the alleged homicide of the architect in 2025 and denies the charges.

stories.title: El Ayuntamiento de Madrid rechaza la propuesta de Urbagestión, pero se abre a una mediación

en.title: Madrid City Council rejects Urbagestión proposal but opens to mediation
en.summary: Madrid's city council has rejected Urbagestión's proposal but is willing to mediate. Maricarmen's representative and the real estate company will meet Monday to negotiate a resolution.

stories.title: La pareja de Josep Juanpere, investigada por su homicidio, queda en libertad bajo fianza de 80.000 euros

en.title: Josep Juanpere's partner investigated for his homicide released on 80,000 euro bail
en.summary: Belén López, partner of 72-year-old architect Josep Juanpere who died in December, was released on bail of 80,000 euros while investigated for homicide. She must pay within three days or face imprisonment, and her passport has been confiscated.

stories.title: La pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere queda en libertad a la espera de abonar la fianza

en.title: Architect Josep Juanpere's partner released pending bail payment
en.summary: The judge ordered provisional imprisonment waivable with an 80,000 euro bail, giving the defendant three days to deposit it.

stories.title: Nueva York rebautiza la Calle 14 como 'Little Spain'

en.title: New York renames 14th Street as 'Little Spain'
en.summary: A street in New York corresponding to a historic century-old Spanish immigrant settlement was renamed Little Spain. The area developed around La Nacional, the oldest Spanish institution in the United States.

stories.title: Las claves bursátiles de la próxima semana

en.title: Stock market key points for next week
en.summary: An overview of important stock market factors expected to influence trading in the upcoming week.

stories.title: Eduardo Luiz Saverin, el exsocio de Zuckerberg cautivado por Singapur

en.title: Eduardo Luiz Saverin, Zuckerberg's former partner captivated by Singapore
en.summary: Saverin renounced U.S. citizenship to reduce taxes during Facebook's public offering. He later founded B Capital in 2015, which manages 12 billion dollars in assets.

stories.title: El Oyster cumple 100 años y Rolex lo celebra con una edición temporal

en.title: The Oyster celebrates 100 years and Rolex marks the occasion with a limited edition
en.summary: Rolex's Oyster model reaches its centennial milestone as the first waterproof and dustproof wristwatch. The company released a limited-edition version to commemorate the anniversary.

stories.title: Talleres de gemología, de perfumería o de moda para aprender viajando

en.title: Gemology, perfumery and fashion workshops to learn while traveling
en.summary: Travel-based learning workshops help maintain educational momentum during vacations when the brain is more receptive to new information and skills.
